versions.changelog: 默认返回最终采集结果，完善异步等待下载与安全恢复；修复空目标误执行、Quick Start、Token 配置和触发路由冲突，并补齐发布前自动化测试
新增能力路由与异步任务闭环，修复失效引用、Token 泄漏和 Skill 元数据兼容性
补全中文文档，更新目录结构

Initial release of Dataify Google Shopping Keywords skill.

- Enables collection of Google Shopping product information by keyword using the Dataify Scraper API.
- Guides users through required parameters, parameter confirmation (with Markdown tables), and task creation workflow.
- Supports multi-keyword and multi-parameter requests.
- Handles Dataify API token securely, with clear prompts for missing or saving tokens.
- Explains helper scripts for parameter preview and API calls.
- Reports task creation status and provides dashboard link for results.
